Name: More Stats
Author: XanCreations
Description:
[center][color=#ffd966][size=5][b]More Stats![/b][/size][/color]
[color=#f1c232][size=2][i]By XanCreations[/i][/size][/color][/center]

[center]Version: 1.0.1
Compatibility: Stardew Valley [1.6+] • Better Game Menu • PC only[/center]


[color=#ffd966][u][b]Description:[/b][/u][/color]
Have you ever wanted to know exactly what your player's stats are without guessing? Would you like your menu to be a little more optimised? And how about a tab to show you some financial information on your sold goods? Maybe more features in the future? The possibilities just got a lot larger with this mod, thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32032]Better Game Menu's[/url] API. There is currently some customisation in the configs and support for multiple languages as well. Player stats are based on weapons, weapon enchantments, boots, rings, trinkets, food buffs, combat professions and books. Riding a horse and if the horse has been fed a carrot is also accounted for in the player's speed stat.


[color=#ffd966][u][b]Current Features:[/b][/u][/color]
[*]The inventory tab previously showed Farm Information, such as the farm name, current funds, total earnings and date. This has now been moved to a completely new tab!

[*]Replacing the Farm Information in the inventory tab is now a list of player stats that show the following:
-> Defense
-> Move Speed
-> Immunity (%)
-> Knockback
-> Weapon (Name of the weapon that is currently equipped) -> This is based on the slot in the inventory you have currently selected.
-> Damage (Min-Max)-> Attack Speed (Super Slow, Very Slow, Slow, Normal, Fast, Very Fast, Super Fast)-> Chance for Crit Hit (%)
-> Crit Damage Multiplier (x)
-> Damage on Crit Hit (Min-Max)

[*]﻿The new [u]Farm Information[/u] tab will display the usual farm name, current funds, total earnings and date. It will also have the following additional information:

-> A [u]Top 5 Sales[/u] column -> displays 5 products that have made you the most money from the shipping bin. These are categorised as "This Season" "This Year" and "All Time". They are updated when you wake up each morning. "This Season" refreshes at the start of the next season and "This Year" refreshes at the start of the next year. "All Time" means it never refreshes, which is useful for letting the player know what has made them the most money over the course of that save.

-> A [u]Sales Tracker[/u] column -> Displays a list of all the product categories you have made money from when you sold them in the shipping bin. For example, if you sold a lot of fruits, but only some vegetables, it might display something like Fruits: 75% and Vegetables: 25%. It will only display up to 10 categories, but it records more than that. I can add more to be recorded but I need to know which custom categories to add. Currently I have added "Creatures" from Nature In The Valley since I am familiar with that already. This also updates when you wake up each day and is based on products sold all time.

[*]Configs have been setup for customising the color of the font for the new features (Headings/Labels/Values). There is also a config for changing the position of the tooltip when the mouse pointer is hovering over an object (Inventory Only/All Tabs)

[*][u][b]!! PLEASE KEEP IN MIND !![/b][/u]
-> For [u]Top 5 Sales[/u] and [u]Sales Tracker[/u], it is based on what the mod has recorded at the time of installing. It will not tell you what you have sold in a previously saved game that didn't have this mod recording from the start. It will also only record what you have sold in a shipping bin. If you sell to shops, it won't record it. Think of it like this, you were selling products but you did not keep a record of anything (did not have this mod installed yet). This mod is like having a bookkeeper, they receive an invoice from Lewis when products are sold from the shipping bin and this updates your records each day. However, products sold in a shop do not produce a receipt, so it isn't recorded. But since most players use a shipping bin to sell products, I didn't think it would be too much of an issue.


[color=#ffd966][u][b]Installation:[/b][/u][/color]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32032]Better Game Menu[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
[*]Extract MoreStats into your mods folder. It will end up being:
[code]﻿﻿StardewValley\Mods\MoreStats
[/code]
[*]Launch via SMAPI. If you want to use the config without GMCM then you need to launch SMAPI at least once to generate the config.
[/list]

[b][color=#ffd966][u]Configs:[/u][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][u]Heading/Label Color[/u] -> You can customise the color of the headings and labels. (Default: black)
[*][u]Value Color[/u] -> You can customise the color of the values, like Defense: 10, the "10" will be shown as a different color. (Default: red)
[*][u]Enable Left Tooltip (Inventory[/u]) -> This allows you to change the position of the tooltip that shows up when you hover over an item. Normally it is sitting to the right of the mouse pointer but this config allows it to be on the left of the pointer. (default: true) -> This is because the tooltip can obscure the stats.
[*][u]Enable Left Tooltip (All)[/u] -> This allows all tabs in the menu to have the tooltip hover to the left instead of the right. (default: false) -> I left this optional in case people like it this way. This will override "Enable Left Tooltip (Inventory)" -> If you want Inventory to be set to false then All would need to be set to false as well. TL;DR both set to false = vanilla default.
[/list]

[color=#ffd966][u][b]Compatibility:[/b][/u][/color]
[list]
[*]Please ensure to check [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32032]Better Game Menu's[/url]﻿ compatibility, as this mod is dependant on it. You can check the [url=https://github.com/KhloeLeclair/StardewMods/issues/43]Compatibility Tracker[/url] for this as well.﻿
[*]I do not believe it works on mobile phone devices. From my understanding of Better Game Menu it is purely for PC at this stage.
[*]I have tested it in multiplayer and split-screen and it works fine.
[*]Works with a controller and for the new Info Tab too!
[*]I added all languages using google translate (sorry if anything isn't quite right). This was because I needed to make sure all languages could fit in the new user interface, with Korean being the biggest hurdle. Please let me know if anything can be adjusted or changed to correct it or fit it better.
[*]The combat stats work with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3214]Wear More Rings[/url]﻿ mod and should work with custom weapons from other mods as well. If there are any mods that don't seem to be compatible please let me know so I can add compatibility for it.
[*]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1845]Bigger Backpack[/url] mod.﻿
[/list]

[b][color=#ffd966][u]Credits:[/u][/color][/b]
Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/138772588]KhloeLeclair[/url] for allowing me to use their API, which was what made this mod possible.


[color=#ffd966][b][u]Purpose and Goal:[/u][/b][/color]
The purpose behind this mod was combat stat and player stat transparency, since I have always wanted to see exactly how everything is calculated. I also felt like the game needed a little bit of financial reporting, since in some ways running a farm is like running a business. So seeing what products are giving you the most value or showing others how well your farm is performing financially adds a little more depth to the game. It can also be a great tool for challenge runs when you want to restrict yourself to selling only specific products.
Another thing as well, as explained in Better Game Menu, the vanilla menu is quite troublesome and I am hoping that in time more players and modders will use Better Game Menu since it allows for more UI customisation and it helps with the performance as well.

Let me know if you have any issues or have any suggestions in the comments. Thanks!
